title: Coefficient bias parameters
statement: For a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input with small-bias parameters $(n,a,b)$ and threshold $\tau$, the coefficient-bias parameters have dimension $n$, numerator $a$, and denominator $b$ times twice the active coefficient cap associated with $\tau$. The dimension and numerator are positive, and twice the numerator is at most the denominator.
hypotheses_covered: The Fourier $1$-norm bound is at least one
caveat: The active coefficient cap is not defined among the supplied upstream definitions, so its mathematical meaning cannot be specified more precisely.
